item.title: Lions seeking Academy Kit & Equipment Co-Ordinator
item.description: Millwall Football Club is hiring an Academy Kit & Equipment Co-Ordinator. Reporting to Kit & Equipment Manager, this role will be responsible for kit and equipment needs for the Academy, ensuring players and staff are fully prepared for training and matchdays. Supporting in the organisation, distribution, and inventory of kit and equipment, the role holder will support the smooth daily operations of the Academy, following the Academy's fixture and training schedules. item.title: Joel Coleman and Caleb Taylor visit Lewisham College
item.description: Millwall First-Team duo Joel Coleman and Caleb Taylor visited Lewisham College as part of Millwall Community Trust’s Post-16 Football & Education Academy. Millwall Community Trust offers a unique opportunity for passionate 16-18-year-olds football players, both male and female, to pursue a two-year Football & Education Scholarship - this course is run at Lewisham College as well as other educational sites. item.title: Fans' Forum to take place at The Den in March
item.description: Millwall Football Club will host a Fans' Forum at The Den on Thursday 12th March. Taking place in 'Arry's Bar between 6-8pm, the first hour of the event will see Alex Neil (Head Coach), Steve Gallen (Director of Football) and Mark Fairbrother (Managing Director) take questions from the floor. item.title: The latest loan update
item.description: Ben Drake was effective at both ends for Braintree Town last weekend. item.title: Tristan Crama nominated for PFA Player of the Month Award
item.description: VOTE FOR TRISTAN HERE!Millwall's Tristan Crama has been nominated for the PFA Championship Fans' Player of the Month Award for February 2026. The Frenchman was an ever-present in Alex Neil's side across the second month of the year as he took part in The Lions' four wins out of five, also scoring in the 3-0 win over Birmingham City at The Den. item.title: A catch-up with Camiel
item.description: Camiel Neghli has spoken to Millwall TV+ ahead of The Lions' trip to Hull City. Alex Neil's side head to the MKM Stadium on Saturday afternoon (kick-off 12.30pm), with Neghli previewing that fixture, as well as discussing the last two games, the benefit of away supporters, his personal form and more. Click below on the video below to hear from Camiel.

item.title: Head Coach on Hull
item.description: A second consecutive away game awaits Alex Neil on Saturday afternoon. The Lions travel to Hull City for a Sky Bet Championship fixture between two of the current Play-Off pack - and the Head Coach sat down with Millwall TV+ to preview the match. Click play on the video below to hear from Alex as he discusses the reaction from the Portsmouth loss, which saw The Lions hit five in two matches, the upcoming task and much more.
